title: Provenance
description: Where a game data record came from. Every record in every game folder carries one (or a non-empty array of them). Enforced by astrix-app/tools/validate-game-folders.mjs.

officialPost.title: Official post
officialPost.description: A publisher or developer post: patch notes, news, developer blog, official forum.

quote.description: Optional exact wording from the post.

inGameCapture.title: In-game capture
inGameCapture.description: A value read in game by a named person. Only the value is committed. No image is stored or committed.

where.description: The in-game screen the value was read from.

clientData.title: Client data
clientData.description: A row from a published client data table, as the WoW Forever pipeline records it today. kind is optional so existing records stay valid.

armory.title: Armory
armory.description: A value read from a publisher's public character armory (no login, no key), such as the AION 2 armory. The response is kept as a test fixture.

endpoint.description: The armory path the value came from.

fixture.description: Optional repo path of the saved response.

communityGuide.title: Community guide
communityGuide.description: A third-party guide, database or press article (for example MetaBot, ExpCarry). Used for build advice, never for character data. Reliability is our own rating of the source.

ref.description: Short id that fields cite in their refs list.
